verdict.rationale: Drive's API documents OAuth scopes that must be defined in the Google Cloud console and in the app (docs-34). It also offers a narrow least-privilege scope limited to "only the specific Google Drive files you use with this app" (docs-8), so an agent can be given restricted credentials rather than full-drive access. The evidence is thin: two short snippets with nothing agent-specific. missing for 10: documented flow for issuing per-agent credentials (e.g., service accounts or delegated tokens), credential expiry/revocation controls, finer-grained per-folder or read-only scope details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
